Comment: The etymon is extremely problematic.; The preterite is appears to belong to the first conjugation in the dialects of Huma and Ţărnareca.

The 1PL and 2PL subjunctive forms are as given in the source. If they are correct they represent a unique distinction between indicative and subjunctive in these cells.The fact that Capidan does not further comment on them makes them doubtful. Elsewhere (1932:168) the subjunctive forms are given as here.
Forms given are specified as being from Țârnareca.
